angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 642,131 km at 251.59 pc = 0.03 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 3.9747 +/- 0.0134 mas (same row, RUWE 1.00): 251.59 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.923 +/- 0.096 solar radii from Sato et al. 2012, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of HAT-P-38 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2012PASJ...64...97S/abstract): 642,131 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.886 +/- 0.044 solar masses from Sato et al. 2012, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of HAT-P-38 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2012PASJ...64...97S/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5330 +/- 100 K from Sato et al. 2012, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HAT-P-38 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2012PASJ...64...97S/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Sato et al. 2012, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HAT-P-38 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2012PASJ...64...97S/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/hat-p-38.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.455, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HAT-P-38 (pscomppars): spectral type G5, from Luo et al. 2018 (http://vizier.u-strasbg.fr/viz-bin/VizieR-3?-source=V/153/stellar4)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HAT-P-38 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.06 dex, from Sato et al. 2012 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2012PASJ...64...97S/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HAT-P-38 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.208, from Sato et al. 2012 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2012PASJ...64...97S/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HAT-P-38 (pscomppars): age 10.1 Gyr, from Bonomo et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...602A.107B/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HAT-P-38 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 0.4 km/s, from Sato et al. 2012 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2012PASJ...64...97S/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
